title: Evolution Pilates

services.name: Group Classes
services.desc: Each of the small group Pilates classes at our Port Washington studio incorporates the 4 S’s of Pilates (stretch, strength, stamina, and stability). As you move through a combination of classes on the reformer, tower, and raised mat you will learn the system that is Pilates. Our Reformer classes hold a maximum of 6 participants and Tower/Mat classes a maximum of 8 so we recommend that you schedule classes in advance. Our classes do fill up so don’t get shut out! Joe Pilates recommended 3 sessions a week and we agree that this is the ideal schedule. Taking a variety of classes will give you the most robust Pilates experience and yield the fastest results to tone, sculpt, and redefine your

services.name: Pilates Classes
services.desc: As we welcome 2025 with open arms, it’s the perfect time to set fresh goals and envision your best year yet! Whether you’re aiming to boost your fitness, embrace a healthier lifestyle, or find balance in body and mind, we’re here to help you crush your goals. Start your year with a commitment to movement and wellness through Pilates. Pilates offers a unique, whole-body approach that builds strength, enhances flexibility, and improves posture while calming the mind. It’s perfect for everyone, whether you’re just starting out or looking to elevate your practice to new heights. At Evolution Pilates, our expert instructors will guide you through a personalized journey to help you feel stronger,

services.name: Teacher Training
services.desc: Evolution Pilates is honored to be a host studio for New York’s world-renowned Real Pilates® Teacher Training program. This licensed vocational school is one of the most respected and rigorous Classical Pilates education programs in the industry and world. This is a 30-week program presented over 600 hours total. The traditional program is designed to develop your ability to become a Pilates instructor, coach, and guide for students. Our approach will set you up for success with a career as a professional instructor. Already a certified teacher wanting to dive deeper into the classical work? Be a bridge student! Learn the “why” of the system, fill in your blanks, and develop your program

services.desc: A mix of private and group sessions gives you a strong foundation and helps you progress confidently. We recommend starting with private sessions if you have injuries or would like a more introduction to Pilates
